polityNote: People’s Republic of Bangladesh from 16 December 1971 (East Bengal / East Pakistan 1947–71 is drawn by OpenHistoricalMap as one province). Atoms: geoBoundaries ADM3 of BGD (2020 upazilas, Bangladesh Bureau of Statistics / OCHA, CC BY 3.0 IGO), the set BRI-provinces-1937.json uses for Bengal. A division is the union of the upazilas of its districts (district from the BBS district layer; division by district). Every division change since 1971 moved whole districts (Barisal 1993, Sylhet 1995, Rangpur 2010, Mymensingh 2015). The upazilas of the enclave belt are withheld for the whole scope: before 31 July 2015 they held Indian enclaves and today’s upazilas do not carry the chhit lines, and the geoBoundaries polygons there still mix the pre-2015 state (Patgram has 16 parts including Bangladeshi chhits that became Indian in 2015, Hatibandha has 2 holes). Replaces the Natural Earth dossier, whose single Dhaka atom held Mymensingh and whose Rajshahi atom could not be drawn before 2015.
